fusions.name: Butt Out of Spite
fusions.desc: A hard-driven sting that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Ledge Clearing
fusions.desc: Bucks every enemy within 2.5 tiles in a blow that deals 12 damage and knocks them back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand the Crag
fusions.desc: Draws up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. An escort of stingers fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Be Moved
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
